question: A settlement in closely built area of dwellings, wherever flat land is available is called _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Compact settlement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A settlement in closely built area of dwellings, wherever flat land is available is called **Compact settlement**.
 
• These settlements **develop generally in the fertile plains** and **valleys**.
 
• The **density **of population is **high **due to productive land.
 
• **Agriculture** is the **main occupation** of the people.
 
• These have **problems** **of sanitation** and **drainage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In urban planning, the **grid plan**, **grid street plan**, or **gridiron plan** is a type of city plan in which **streets run at right angles** to each other, forming a grid.
 
• A **Line settlement **or **Linear settlement **is a collection of buildings or a settlement that is created in a long line; these are often modest to medium-sized settlements.
 
 
• A lot of these **communities are built along transportation corridors** like **roads**, **rivers**, or **canals**.
 
• Others arise as a result of geographical limitations like hills, valleys, mountains, and coasts. A linear colony might not have a clear center.
 
 
 
• One of the primary categories of settlement patterns that landscape historians use to categorize rural communities in England and other countries is the **dispersed settlement**, also referred to as the **scattered settlement.**
 
 
• Usually, the region is made up of several distinct farmsteads dispersed all across it.
 
• Houses in dispersed villages are few and spaced widely apart.
 
• These kinds of villages are typically found in **high terrain regions**, **hot deserts**, grasslands, deep forests, and vast agricultural fields.
